decisive_steps.step: Use of Kneser's chromatic-number theorem and the degree-form regularity lemma.
decisive_steps.checked: Both are standard theorems stated in applicable forms. The Kneser parameters satisfy N>=2k with k positive. The regularity application uses fixed positive d,epsilon and sufficiently large n; its degree bound gives m*delta(R)>=(c-d-2epsilon)n.

decisive_steps.checked: Verified each support constraint by constructing the prohibited closed odd walk. Majority-neighborhood classes are wide. Otherwise signatures force three supports to be pairwise anticomplete; together with the edge constraints this makes the three supports and their three reduced neighborhoods pairwise disjoint. Their sizes give km>=(9c-3d-24epsilon)n>n, the required contradiction.
